# Burj Al Hamam

> Burj Al Hamam is a Lebanese restaurant at The Dubai Mall in Downtown Dubai, serving mezze, charcoal grills and other Levantine dishes. It shares its name with a long-established restaurant brand of Beirut origin. The Dubai Mall is one of the world's largest shopping centres, drawing tens of millions of visitors a year to its shops, aquarium and setting beside Burj Khalifa.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Downtown Dubai, UAE
- Status: Completed

## MENASCO Scope

Burj Al Hamam is a Lebanese restaurant at The Dubai Mall in Downtown Dubai, serving Lebanese and Middle Eastern cuisine. This project covered an extension of the existing outlet, delivered for Binhendi Enterprises. MENASCO carried out the MEP fit-out works for the extension, providing the building services needed to support the enlarged restaurant within one of Dubai's principal retail destinations.
